band.text: Weighed 3.73 kg ( 8.2 lb) on Sep 16, 2026 on a home scale, a single reading, down from 4.40 kg ( 9.7 lb) on Jun 15, 2026 on a home scale, a single reading — about 15 % of body weight. No weigh-in is recorded after it: it is 45 days ( 6 weeks) before Oct 31, 2026, when this report was generated. The latest reading against the highest before it in the last 365 days, not a diagnosis; body condition was not assessed. The owner was told it is worth booking a vet visit. Intake was recorded for 3 of 219 meals logged in this window , so this record cannot show how much Nyx is eating.

band.label: Diet not eaten
band.text: 2 of 4 rated feedings carrying the trial diet left unfinished (entries with the diet in them, treats included) on 2 days between Sep 21 and Oct 8; no trial-diet feeding rated since shows whether that has changed. Trial diet: Royal Canin Selected Protein PR, Dry + 5 other trial items. Dates covered: Sep 16 – Oct 20, 2026. Refusal of a prescribed diet is a clinical finding in its own right , not a preference. In cats, ≥48–72 h of markedly reduced intake is a hepatic-lipidosis risk window. Shown because it is present in the log; it is not a measure of how much was eaten overall. Intake ratings on the sheet headed “Intake per feeding”.

band.label: Chronicity
band.text: Vomiting spans 44 days (first logged Sep 17): 14 episodes on 12 days; most recent today. A sustained pattern over many samples, not a single incident. Cough and vomiting are both flagged chronic for this patient. Post-tussive vomiting, and cough mistaken for hairball retching, are common in both directions, so either count may be understated as readily as overstated — both are owner-classified, reported separately and un-reclassified. This window opens Sep 16, so 44 days is a floor — the record cannot show how long the sign predates it.

band.label: Chronicity
band.text: Coughing spans 34 days (first logged Sep 17): 5 episodes on 5 days; most recent 10 days ago. A sustained pattern over many samples, not a single incident. This window opens Sep 16, so 34 days is a floor — the record cannot show how long the sign predates it.

record_lines.text: Vomiting: 16 entries (14 episodes as the flag counts them) on 12 of 45 logged days, the last Oct 31.
Meals (logged as meals, not treats): 219 logged; 3 rated, intake not recorded for 216; 2 not fully eaten, counting 1 “ate most”, on 2 days, first Sep 21, last Oct 2 (29 days before this report).
Coughing: 5 entries on 5 of 45 logged days, the last Oct 21.
Sneezing: 3 entries on 3 of 45 logged days, the last Oct 24.
Prednisolone: given on 15 of 21 course days (11 partial).
Noticed: answered on 15 of 46 days; “Hunched or tucked up” on 1 (Sep 25).

Not a test of the diet alone. Overlapping the trial: Motozol, overlapping it Jul 26 to Aug 9; Motozol, overlapping it Sep 21 to Sep 27; Prednisolone, overlapping it Sep 21 to Oct 11; Cetirizine HCl (Zyrtec) (entered as a supplement), overlapping it Jul 26 to Oct 20 (ad-hoc, by Jul 1). Spans are the courses as recorded, not evidence of administration.

2 of 4 rated feedings of the trial diet were not finished; only 4 feedings of the trial diet carry a rating, so this record cannot show the diet was eaten as fed — the coverage figure describes how completely it was tracked, not whether the diet was fed exclusively.
Weight is down about 15 % of body weight across the trial’s start (Jun 15, 2026 → Sep 16, 2026; above).

The trial diet was not fed exclusively: 11 of 167 feedings in the 35 trial days this report covers did not match it on Oct 18, Oct 19 and Oct 20, 2026 (the sheet headed “Diet history and food exposure”; a floor, not a total), so this record shows an elimination that was broken, not a clean one. 18 doses by mouth in the 35 trial days this report covers may carry a protein (above), so the elimination cannot be confirmed clean from this record.
The trial diet’s own label ( Royal Canin Selected Protein PR, Dry ) also lists Pea protein and Hydrolyzed soy protein (above), so this record cannot establish that the elimination was clean.

The ingredient panels of 5 of the 6 trial-diet foods ( Royal Canin Selected Protein PR, Wet ; Rayne Clinical Nutrition RABBIT - RAYNE REWARDS S.I.T. ; Instinct Limited Ingredient Diet Real Rabbit Recipe in Savory Gravy ; and 2 more) were not read, so a protein in them beyond the one recorded would appear nowhere in this record, and the elimination cannot be confirmed clean from it.
Motozol ( 2 courses), Prednisolone and Cetirizine HCl (Zyrtec) (entered as a supplement) overlapped the trial, so a change in the signs the trial is measuring cannot be attributed to the diet alone.

As of this report, Nyx lives with 1 other cat, so another animal’s food may have been available during the trial (intake not directly observed) — this record does not say whether feeding was kept separate.
